Subject: Transition plan: temporary deputy & Q1 check-in notes

Team —

Quick, sensitive update and ask. As discussed in the leadership sync yesterday, Sam Patel (Product) will be out on an extended leave starting 3/1 for personal reasons. We need to stand up a temporary deputy to handle day-to-day product delivery and to own the Q1 check-ins and final calibration that lands next week.

What I need from this thread by EOD tomorrow (Fri 2/20):
- Consolidated manager notes for Sam's direct reports (one paragraph per report; any open performance concerns called out explicitly).
- A short deputy proposal (name + 3 reasons) and a mitigation plan if that person needs backfill support.
- Any items that need HR/legal review flagged now (confidentiality, accommodations, compensation exceptions).

I attached a draft transition-plan (transition-plan-v0.2.docx) and a proposed org chart snippet (org-chart-proposal.png). For confidentiality, please do not forward outside the people listed here — Emily from TalentPartners is on as our external HR advisor for the moment.

If anyone thinks a different approach (e.g., splitting deputy responsibility across two ICs) is materially better, note it in your manager notes. I will consolidate and prepare a short script for the manager conversation.

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Avery — thanks for flagging. I pulled together my manager notes (attached) and a short deputy proposal. Highlights below: 

- Proposed deputy: Marcus Lin — has run two cross-functional launches with Sam, strong prioritization, trusted by eng and PM.
- Backup option: Priya Natarajan (PM) — good stakeholder skills but would need bandwidth support.
- Manager notes attached (manager-notes-q1.pdf) with one-paragraph summaries and two calibration flags (candidate A: performance trending up but missed one delivery; candidate B: needs coaching on cross-team influence).

Confidential note: One direct report (Ethan Park) has a formal coaching plan that HR should be aware of before we finalize role changes. Emily — can you confirm whether that coaching plan affects eligibility for temporary step-ups?

If we go with Marcus, I recommend a 2-week overlap with Sam before 3/1 for handoff; otherwise plan for a condensed 48-hour deep-dive.

- The active coaching plan (Ethan Park) does not automatically block someone from being considered for a temporary deputy role; we only need to ensure the manager conversation is framed appropriately and that any performance-related commitments are not retracted mid-plan.
- If Marcus is given temporary authority for budgetary decisions, we recommend a $5k discretionary cap without additional approvals. Anything above should route to Lauren or to finance as pre-approved exceptions.
- I reviewed transition-plan-v0.2 and left inline comments on the drive doc (link in your folder). Kate — legal is ready to do a 30-minute read if you want a quick signoff on temporary authority language.

I'll join the 2/20 11:00am calibration briefly. If you want, I can draft the manager script language that addresses the coaching plan and temporary authority (will share as a short paragraph for your packet).
